source:
Create a Roblox game called Echofall.
Genre: Multiplayer Adventure, Exploration, Survival and Social Strategy.
The map is a massive floating world made of islands connected by bridges, caves, forests, snowy mountains, volcanoes, deserts and ancient ruins.
Every new server starts with the exact same peaceful world.
Hidden in the game is an invisible system called "The Echo."
Every player action adds points to different Echo categories:
• Fighting increases Chaos. • Building increases Civilization. • Exploring increases Discovery. • Helping players increases Harmony. • Destroying nature increases Corruption.
Every five minutes, whichever category is strongest permanently changes the server.
Examples:
Chaos creates stronger monsters, meteor showers and dangerous weather.
Harmony creates healing springs, friendly creatures and safe villages.
Civilization causes NPCs to build towns, roads and trading posts.
Discovery reveals secret caves, floating islands and hidden bosses.
Corruption slowly transforms forests into dark biomes with unique loot.
None of these events are announced beforehand. Players only notice the world changing around them.
Every server develops differently depending on its players.
Add over 150 random world events.
Examples include:
Giant walking castles.
Dragon migrations.
Ancient doors opening.
Floating whales flying through the sky.
Eclipse events.
Treasure storms.
Underground kingdoms appearing.
Living forests.
Crystal rain.
Giant sea monsters.
Every event should be rare and unpredictable.
Players begin with nothing.
Progress by crafting equipment, discovering recipes, unlocking abilities, collecting pets and earning Echo powers.
Instead of traditional levels, players gain Reputation from exploration, teamwork and achievements.
Reputation unlocks cosmetics, titles, mounts and emotes instead of stronger weapons.
Hidden around the world are mysterious Echo Relics.
When enough relics are activated together, the entire server enters a unique Endgame State.
There should be at least 20 different Endgame States, each completely transforming the world.
Examples:
Eternal Night.
Sky Kingdom.
Frozen World.
Machine Civilization.
Ocean Planet.
Monster Dominion.
Ancient Gods Return.
Every Endgame State has exclusive bosses, loot, music, weather and visual effects.
Add dynamic music that changes depending on the world's condition.
Include day/night cycles, realistic weather, seasons and natural disasters.
Create highly detailed environments with vibrant lighting, particles and cinematic effects.
Design every creature with unique behaviours instead of simple attacks.
NPCs should remember player actions and react differently based on reputation.
Add hidden puzzles requiring multiple players to solve together.
Include thousands of collectible items, hundreds of armour sets, rare mounts, pets, emotes, titles and visual cosmetics.
Keep all gameplay fair with no pay-to-win mechanics.
Monetisation should only include cosmetics, pets, visual effects, animations, emotes and premium housing decorations.
Optimise the game for mobile, console and PC with smooth performance.
The goal is to create a world where every server tells a completely different story, encouraging players to return because they never know what adventure will happen next.

answers.ask: A world this size cannot be framed in one top-down image - should we build the starting island cluster first and decompose the rest of the biomes into separate maps?
answers.answer: Build the starting island cluster first as the playable vertical slice, with the remaining biomes planned as separate connected maps to expand later.

answers.ask: Should the map depict the peaceful starting world, or one of the transformed Echo states?
answers.answer: Depict the exact same peaceful starting world every new server begins with; Echo transformations emerge during play rather than being the default map state.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: A world this size cannot be framed in one top-down image - should we build the starting island cluster first and decompose the rest of the biomes into separate maps? A: Build the starting island cluster first as the playable vertical slice, with the remaining biomes planned as separate connected maps to expand later.
- [author] goal — Q: Should the map depict the peaceful starting world, or one of the transformed Echo states? A: Depict the exact same peaceful starting world every new server begins with; Echo transformations emerge during play rather than being the default map state.

## Enriched image prompt
Create the peaceful starting vertical slice of a vibrant high-fantasy floating world: a cluster of forested islands suspended in open sky and linked by walkable bridges. Give the cluster varied natural relief, a few hidden carved caves, ancient ruins as the main visible landmark, readable exploration trails, and bridge approaches that keep every starting island connected. Place mysterious relic sites in discoverable but unobtrusive positions and include a small ambient population of peaceful creatures. Frame only this coherent starting cluster in detail; snowy mountains, volcanic lands, and desert lands belong to later separate connected maps rather than being compressed into this image. Use highly detailed environments, vibrant lighting, restrained particles, and a cinematic but readable composition.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Adventure, with Survival secondary because crafting, gathering, and adapting to threats support the exploration-led world.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered`, a Chaptered Journey in which the starting island cluster and later biomes are genuinely separate connected maps. The matching preset is Exploration, substituting this multi-map container shape while retaining exploration trails, discoveries, and a focal landmark.

## Config requirements
Use the universal `island-cluster` for the bridged floating starting islands; `path-trail` for foot routes joining bridges, caves, and ruins; `landmark-focal` for the ancient ruin complex; `alcove-secret` for hidden cave cutouts; `terrain-relief` for the islands' varied landforms and cave overhangs; `gate-chapter` for ancient thresholds reserved for future biome maps; and the universal `npc-population` for peaceful creatures inhabiting the starting cluster.

## Layout requirements
Place `collectible-nodes` as hidden Echo Relic activation sites across separate starting islands, with their count configurable because none was stated. Place the layout half of `npc-population` on safe forest and ruin-adjacent ground. No transformed-state hazards or hostile spawners belong in the peaceful default map.

## Layout components
The top-level container has four map segments: the current Starting Island Cluster, shaped as `island-cluster` with forests, bridges, caves, trails, and ruins; a future Snowy Mountains map; a future Volcanic Lands map; and a future Desert Lands map, each an explorable `world-open` region. Only the starting cluster is rendered now. Its open-sky boundary, bridges, relief, caves, ruin landmark, relic sites, and ambient creature ground must all remain legible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish island and bridge connectivity first, then dress the authoritative plan in isometric high-fantasy detail.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The current scale band is large, preserving caves, ruins, bridges, and relic sites while deferring the full massive world to separate maps. The theme is vibrant cinematic high fantasy in a peaceful floating world. `P4` is required for the current and future separate maps, `P2` for caves and overlapping floating relief, and `CHECK` for the open-air gaps around the island cluster.

options.text: A cluster of forested floating islands suspended in open sky, linked by walkable bridges.
Readable exploration trails and foot routes joining bridges, caves, and the ancient ruins.
An ancient ruin complex as the main visible landmark that draws exploration.
A few hidden carved cave cutouts tucked into the islands.
Varied natural relief across the islands, including cave overhangs and layered floating terrain.
Ancient thresholds reserved for later connected biome maps (snowy mountains, volcanic lands, desert lands).
A small ambient population of peaceful creatures inhabiting the starting island cluster.
Hidden Echo Relic activation sites placed across separate starting islands in discoverable but unobtrusive positions.

layout_placement.text: Peaceful creatures placed on safe forest ground and on ground adjacent to the ruins.
layout_placement.where: on safe forest and ruin-adjacent ground

layout_placement.text: Hidden Echo Relic activation sites across separate starting islands.

layout.composition: Frame only the coherent Starting Island Cluster in detail as a floating bridged island cluster in open sky, with the ancient ruin complex as the main visible landmark and exploration trails leading to caves, bridges, and relic sites; later biomes (Snowy Mountains, Volcanic Lands, Desert Lands) are separate connected maps and are not included in the framed scene.
